Do not count seeing the landmark from another heading as completion.

capture.goal: Drive on the RIGHT around a connected compact street block and visibly return to THIS starting intersection with yellow hillside buildings ahead-LEFT and red-orange corner building RIGHT, with the same heading. Use the attached starting reference to verify return. Choose every control solely from screenshots; verify actual completed turns, avoid curbs, collisions, traffic and pedestrians. Do not count seeing the landmark from another heading as completion.
capture.autonomy: Astra chooses every driving control phase. Wrapper only handles reset, recording and export.
capture.measured_duration_source: MP4 container duration reported by FFmpeg
capture.duration_note: Full window recording preserves real elapsed time: 100% during actions and 50% during inference. Native GS capture separately preserves all emulator frames; its fixed-rate playback does not preserve slow motion.

outcome.notes: Entered junction and nearly achieved first-right heading, but lane recovery incomplete. Pole collision confirmed visually.

capability_checks.budget_prompt: ae6d49d retained; ff72fda adds evidence-qualified continuation lesson

decision.rationale: Near right curb, parallel to lane edges; no established motion. Clear junction mouth ahead; approach before turning.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Initial approach, 0 turns; next right at visible junction ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: Motion uncalibrated; reference is not a motion sample. Front remains before junction mouth. Short acceleration then coast tests travel before committing to right turn.

decision.rationale: Right-lane curb edge, nose angled toward sidewalk; advanced toward pole. Crossing cars block the junction ahead.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Approach at curb, 0 turns; next right at junction ahead after traffic clears.
decision.dynamics_note: 30 throttle +30 coast moved forward toward corner, with rightward drift despite no steering. Crossing traffic and curb constrain advance; brake then hold, verify stop and front clearance.

decision.rationale: At right curb, angled into sidewalk; little pole-relative progress. Rear car close; ease left away from pedestrian.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. Still approach, 0 turns; recover curb clearance before right at junction ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: 20 brake +40 handbrake left car at curb; rear traffic now close, reverse unsafe. Small forward-left correction seeks road clearance; stop before crossing traffic, yaw response still uncalibrated.

decision.rationale: Right wheels at curb, nose still right of road heading; advanced into pole. Open door; pedestrian ahead-right.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns; curb/pole recovery on approach, then right at junction still ahead.
decision.dynamics_note: 22 left+40 total throttle advanced into pole with insufficient left yaw; pole fell, door open. Rear car prevents reverse. Extend moving left correction, brake before crossing lane and pedestrian.

decision.rationale: Right-lane edge, nose angled left away from curb; advanced and yawed left. Junction ahead; pedestrian at right corner.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 turns; moved off curb on approach. Next right at junction ahead, yielding to corner pedestrian.
decision.dynamics_note: 35 throttle-left produced clear forward travel and substantial left yaw; door closed. Front now points off curb. Brief straight advance seeks corner clearance; brake for pedestrian and crossing traffic.

decision.rationale: At right-lane edge, nose left of road heading; advanced past curb tip. Right street mouth ahead; pedestrian clear left.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; at junction mouth, initiating right into near lane after pedestrian cleared left.
decision.dynamics_note: 25 throttle then braking advanced modestly toward curb end, no blockage established. Leftward heading persists. Advance before 32-frame right arc; brake to limit unverified corner trajectory.

decision.rationale: Inside junction near right-lane mouth, angled right but not aligned; advanced beyond curb tip. Taxi crosses from left.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; partial right at mouth alongside. Yield crossing traffic, then finish right.
decision.dynamics_note: 18 straight+32 right throttle moved beyond curb end with moderate right yaw; 10 brake left lights on, stop unconfirmed. Crossing taxi constrains arc; hold brake until near lane clears.

decision.rationale: Across destination centerline, nose toward far curb; drifted forward then held. Right corridor alongside is clear.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; partial right overshot toward cross-street centerline. Finish right, recover near lane.
decision.dynamics_note: Despite held handbrake, inference showed forward displacement; last 60 handbrake then held position. Far curb limits nose clearance. Extend right arc to 45 frames from rest, then brake; alignment unverified.

decision.rationale: Outside right lane, nose diagonal toward far curb/pole; advanced with right yaw but front clearance is tight.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. 0 completed turns; partial right across centerline near far curb. Recover clearance, finish right into near lane.
decision.dynamics_note: 45 throttle-right+15 brake advanced toward far pole with substantial right yaw, still diagonal. Reverse-left seeks nose clearance and road alignment; rear roadway visible. Hold brake after recovery; result unverified.

decision.rationale: Near centerline, nearly parallel to road after reversing away from pole; taxi close behind-left, rightward path open.
decision.route_note: Start: yellow hillside ahead-left, red-orange corner right. First right heading nearly achieved; lane recovery incomplete. Move into right lane, then seek next right.
decision.dynamics_note: 45 reverse-left gave substantial backward travel and clockwise yaw, clearing nose from curb; taxi now limits rear. Short forward-right correction targets near lane; brake before unverified diagonal drift.
